missing_event_candidate.description: The client first establishes the expected behavior that a new HubSpot follow-up list can be exported seamlessly to MeetAlfred without manual campaign cleanup.

unresolved_candidate.description: The client asked about communication history, CRM membership visibility, profile URLs, and silent-lead follow-up, but the visible acceptance reply does not explicitly confirm each proposed solution. Retain the atoms provisionally and verify their authority during Event Extraction.

The exact lifecycle of direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization is uncertain: the direct path was blocked, an Apollo-mediated path was accepted, and later messages left the optional direct integration under consideration.
The forwarding request repeats argentics.io as both source and destination; context suggests the intended source may be argentics-games.io, but this should not be inferred without adjudication.

Messages initially describe Zapier as unable to create a MeetAlfred campaign, then establish a manual campaign-creation and duplicated-Zap workflow. Event extraction should distinguish the unsupported automatic creation behavior from the accepted manual workflow.

The exact final reporting implementation is not visible: custom reports were cost-prohibitive and the client accepted default reports for now, but it is unclear whether filtered CRM views were also configured.

The December outbound-campaign discussion appears to concern prospective follow-on work, and the detailed scope document is unavailable. The provisional outbound Requirements should remain low- or medium-confidence until the document or explicit engagement decision is reviewed.
